title: scheduler state.json not updated in 1337h
evidence: updated_at=2026-07-25T19:34:38.418340+00:00 — queue is derived from job files, but frozen state hides daemon death

notes.note: PROBE MISCALIBRATED - fixed in bin/tc_ops.py. state.json['updated_at'] was written once by the scheduler's 'init' (2026-07-25) and is NEVER touched by claim/activate/heartbeat/release; the fields that move are the global version counter (5365) and each GPU entry. The check read a vestigial field and warned 'frozen 1337h' on every probe while the 4090 was actively claimed and heartbeating. Now it alerts on the real condition: a GPU held busy/claimed whose heartbeat is >45min stale (UTC parsing via calendar.timegm, not mktime).
